title: Lyn Buchanan brought to an underground site with a reconstructed airliner-UFO collision

tellings.quote: they had reconstructed FAA style a collision between an airliner and a UFO

plain: A man named Lyn Buchanan is said to have been taken to a deep underground site in California where a collision between an airliner and a UFO had been pieced back together, the way air-crash investigators rebuild a wreck. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, repeating what he says Buchanan told him; if true, it would mean such a collision happened and was hidden from the public.
